Gearslip 0.5.0 replaces the car's left rail and mini player with one bottom dock, and adds updates from the phone app.

## Car dock
- A single dock runs along the bottom of every car screen: a volume stepper, NAV, MEDIA, PHONE, CAR, all apps, and VOICE.
- MEDIA opens the full player, and the dock stays on screen while the player is open.
- Weather, Dashboard, and Screensaver now sit in the apps grid, so every place on the old rail is still one tap away.
- PHONE and VOICE keep their designed look, but do not act yet.

## Updates
- Settings > Check for updates finds a new build, downloads the APK made for your phone's processor, checks its SHA-256, and installs it.
- Gearslip ships one APK per processor and a universal fallback, so an update is about 20 MB instead of 35 MB.
- An install you start during a drive waits until the car lets go. The first install asks you to allow Gearslip to install apps.
